title: Holding Money Back for Card Transactions Not Yet Settled at Closure
content:
Money is kept back from the balance given up on a closing Ridgecrest Healthy Options Card programme for transactions the member made before the closing day that have not yet settled, and how much is kept back turns on how old the oldest of them is.

**The rule.** What is kept back for card transactions made before the closing day which have not yet settled is the whole of those transactions, where such a transaction stands on the card made no longer before the closing day than the days the card's tier allows a retailer to send a refund in; it is the largest single transaction the card's tier will authorise, or the whole of those transactions where they come to less, where such a transaction stands made longer before the closing day than that but still inside the days the card's tier gives the member to question a purchase; and it is nothing in every other case.

**How the age is measured.** A transaction not yet settled is one standing authorised on the card. Its age is the whole days from the day the most recent such transaction was posted to the closing day. That age is set against two terms of the card's tier: the days that tier allows a retailer to send a refund in, and the days that tier gives the member to question a purchase.

| The age of the unsettled transactions | What is kept back |
|---|---|
| not more than the days the tier allows a retailer to send a refund in | the whole of those transactions |
| more than that, but not more than the days the tier gives the member to question a purchase | the largest single transaction the tier will authorise, or the whole of those transactions where they come to less |
| more than the days the tier gives the member to question a purchase, or no such transaction at all | nothing |

**Worked through on hypothetical figures.** On a card whose tier allows a retailer 5 calendar days to send a refund, gives the member 75 calendar days to question a purchase and will authorise no single transaction above 250.00 USD: unsettled transactions of 60.00 USD posted 3 days before the closing day are kept back in full, at 60.00 USD. The same transactions posted 40 days before the closing day are kept back at the lower of 250.00 USD and 60.00 USD, that is 60.00 USD; had they come to 300.00 USD, 250.00 USD would be kept back. Posted 80 days before the closing day, nothing is kept back.
